title: Philippine real estate transaction and estate tax reference
scope: Illustrative orientation for Batangas residential and vacant-land transactions.
authorityNote: Statutory rates published by the BIR, the Registry of Deeds, the LGU and the National Treasury. Rates are reproduced here for orientation only. The BIR and the LGU determine the actual amounts payable, and any figure in this file may be superseded by a later circular or statute.
taxBaseNote: For capital gains tax and documentary stamp tax the base is the HIGHER of the selling price and the fair market value, whichever is greater. This guide cannot know either with certainty: the selling price has not happened yet and the BIR determines fair market value, which under Sec. 24(D) of the NIRC may be taken as 50% of the zonal value. Figures below therefore use the higher of the guide estimate and 50% of the BIR zonal value, and are stated as a floor for planning rather than a payable amount.

transaction.label: Capital gains tax
transaction.note: On the excess of the selling price over the fair market value, where positive. Where the selling price does not exceed fair market value there is no CGT, but the guide cannot confirm which applies because the BIR sets fair market value.
transaction.deadlineFrom: date of notarisation of the deed of sale
transaction.penalty: 25% surcharge plus 12% interest per annum on the unpaid tax

transaction.label: Documentary stamp tax
transaction.legalBasis: Sec. 247, National Internal Revenue Code, as amended by RA 11315
transaction.note: Imposed on the deed of sale itself. Payable to the BIR within 5 days of notarisation.
transaction.deadlineFrom: date of notarisation of the deed of sale

transaction.label: Local transfer tax
transaction.note: Local. Outside the National Capital Region the LGU may impose up to 0.5% of the higher of the original purchase price, current value or fair market value. Batangas is outside NCR, so 0.5% is the ceiling here.
transaction.deadlineFrom: date of the deed of transfer
transaction.penalty: Interest and penalties fixed by local ordinance

transaction.label: Registration fee (estimate)
transaction.note: An approximation for orientation. The Registry of Deeds computes the fee from its own schedule, which includes a minimum and is not a flat percentage.

transaction.label: Notarial fee (estimate)
transaction.legalBasis: Notarial rates fixed by the Supreme Court
transaction.note: Charged per notarial act, not as a percentage of the price. Shown as an allowance only; ask the notary.

transaction.label: Broker's commission
transaction.note: Customarily 3% to 5% of the agreed price. Conventionally split between seller and buyer; confirm in writing.

estate.grossEstateBasis: The value of the estate at the time of death, typically the BIR zonal value or the market value, whichever the BIR accepts.
estate.taxBasis: Sec. 28(E) of the TRAIN Law (RA 10963), which raised the taxable threshold to PHP 10,000,000 of net estate
estate.note: Estate tax applies only to the portion of the net estate that exceeds PHP 10,000,000 after the PHP 5,000,000 standard deduction. Most ordinary residential property in Batangas falls below that threshold, so no estate tax is ordinarily payable. Confirm with a lawyer or tax practitioner before relying on that.
